86484: Cortech Razorback Stackable Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-86484-razorback-stackable-chair
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/razorback-chair/
Spec sheet: 86484
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Razorback Stackable Chair – 86484
Current H1: Cortech Razorback - Stackable Chair - High‑Strength Rotationally Molded Polypropylene - Model 86484
Subtitle: Virtually Unbreakable One-Piece Molded Stack Chair with Muscle-Back Legs, Rated for Outdoor Use
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 86484BK, 86484B, 86484FG, 86484T, 86484SB, 86484P, 86484BG, 86484GN, 86884BN Razorback Stackable Chair
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Razorback Stackable Chair is a virtually unbreakable stack chair for dayrooms, dining areas, classrooms, and group rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. Its low back and Muscle-Back legs make it harder to rock and tip over, and the chairs stack for storage.
The chair is injection molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polypropylene, with no steel or wood components. It weighs just over 8 lbs, has a 1,500 lb static load, and its legs have a bolt-down option. The Razorback is rated for indoor or outdoor use.
Material: One-piece injection molded high impact “no break” polypropylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 21”W×21”D×30”H
Weight: 8.25 lbs
Static Load: 1,500 lbs (ANSI/BIFMA X5.1-2011)
Stacking: Stack 8 to 10 chairs on a dolly, or as high as you can comfortably reach without one; chair dolly sold separately
Legs: Muscle-Back legs reduce rocking and tipping and include a bolt-down option
Testing: Passes ASTM F1561-03
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Outdoor Use: Suitable for indoor or outdoor use; resists UV exposure and moisture
Easy Cleaning: Easy to clean with a damp cloth; resistant to stains
Colors: Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Buff, Fog Gray, Green, Plum, Slate Blue, or Teal (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
86484 – Razorback Stackable Chair: 21”W×21”D×30”H, 8.25 lbs
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Optional; the Muscle-Back legs have a pilot hole for field drilling to bolt the chair down. Hardware not included
[H2] Applications
The Razorback suits rooms that need light, stackable chairs that are hard to break, rock, or tip.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, dining areas, and visitation rooms in correctional facilities and jails
Group rooms and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Schools, shelters, and other intense use settings
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Seating
Cortech seating is molded for dayrooms, lounges, dining areas, and patient rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities, where chairs are used hard every day and must be difficult to break or tamper with.
Cortech seating includes:
Stacking Chairs: The Razorback injection molded stack chair
Lounge and Group Seating: The Sabre Lounge Chair and the Sentinel Arm and Armless Chairs, which stand alone or bolt together
Rocking Chairs: The Radial Rocker
Summit Series: Guest chairs, accent chairs, lounge chairs, and stools, with an optional Veldura soft-touch finish
Endurance Series: Crew chairs, benches, and floor mounted stools
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (54 characters): Cortech Razorback Stackable Chair - 86484 at Anchortex
Meta description (152 characters): Shop the Cortech Razorback Stackable Chair. A virtually unbreakable one-piece molded stack chair with Muscle-Back legs, rated for indoor or outdoor use.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Seating" is a new section for the Razorback, Sabre, Sentinel, and Radial Rocker pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: I took out "High-Strength Rotationally Molded Polypropylene" and "Model." The Cortech spec sheet says the Razorback is injection molded, not rotationally molded.
Weight: your variant is set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says 8.25 lbs, so I used that.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Stacking: the Cortech spec sheet says to stack 8 to 10 chairs on a dolly. The FAQ on the Cortech web page says 20 chairs stack to about 7 feet. I used the spec sheet.
Chair dolly: your current page names the dolly DY9000. The Cortech spec sheet does not give a model number, so I wrote "chair dolly sold separately."
Floor mounting: the Cortech spec sheet says the Muscle-Back legs include a bolt-down option. The pilot hole for field drilling comes from your current page.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the Razorback resists UV exposure and moisture and is suitable for indoor or outdoor use, so I added it to the description.
Colors: your current page lists the same 9 colors as the Cortech spec sheet, but the Brown code is written "86884BN." The Cortech code is 86484BN.
I left out "Cost effective economical," since it is a marketing claim.
Product images: the page has three images, including a color chart with the 9 Razorback colors. The Cortech product page has photos of the Razorback in all 9 colors. Would you like me to add them?
